questions.prompt: How should the user trigger 'Assess Sources' from the TUI?
questions.description: Currently: 'a' key in NOTEBOOK_DETAIL opens 'Assess Audio Overview'. A new parallel action is needed for 'Assess Sources'. The keypress module already handles 's' (source selection/ingest) and other single letters. A two-letter sequence or a new letter is available.
questions.recommendedAnswer: A new key binding, e.g. 'S' (shift-s), that starts 'Assess Sources' from NOTEBOOK_DETAIL — parallel to 'a' for audio assessment.

options.label: 'S' (Shift-s) key in NOTEBOOK_DETAIL view
A new entry in the detail-view action menu (no new key)
Reuse the existing source-picker UI, with a mode toggle to choose between Ingest and Assess

questions.prompt: Should the user pick which already-ingested sources to assess, or should it assess all ingested sources for the notebook automatically?
questions.description: The existing source picker (selecting_sources + ingest_sources state) is already wired for Ingest. A similar picker could be reused/adapted for Assess.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All already-ingested sources for the notebook are assessed automatically — no extra picker needed for MVP.

options.label: All already-ingested sources automatically (simpler, no picker)
Reuse the source picker so the user can choose a subset

questions.prompt: Where should the new source-based assessment logic live?
questions.description: The audio path lives in assessment.py (run_full_assessment). A parallel function is needed for the source path. Should it be a new top-level function in the same module, or a separate module?
questions.recommendedAnswer: A new function run_source_assessment() in the same _app/assessment.py — keeps all assessment orchestration co-located.

options.label: New function run_source_assessment() in _app/assessment.py
New _app/source_assessment.py module

questions.prompt: What should be used as 'system_instructions' for source-based scoring? (AudioOverviewAssessor currently takes system_instructions from the audio artifact's prompt.)
questions.description: Without an audio artifact there is no 'prompt'. The DSPy signature and generate_assessment() both take system_instructions as a required field.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Use the notebook's AI-generated summary (resolve_notebook_context) as system_instructions, falling back to an empty string.

options.label: Notebook AI summary (resolve_notebook_context), empty string fallback
Prompt the user for custom system instructions before running
Always pass empty string — let the LLM score without instructions

questions.prompt: AssessmentResult and the DSPy scorer have an 'audio_metadata' field. How should the source-assess path populate it?
questions.description: This field is displayed in the assessment view's left panel and passed to the scorer. For source-based assessment there is no audio.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Populate it with a JSON object describing the assessed sources (source IDs, count), labeled clearly as 'source_metadata' to distinguish from audio runs.

options.label: JSON blob with source IDs and count, displayed as 'Source Metadata'
Empty string / N/A — the field is audio-only, just blank it

questions.prompt: What should happen if the user triggers 'Assess Sources' but no sources have been ingested yet for that notebook?
questions.description: The audio path shows 'No generated audio overview found for <id>' and aborts gracefully.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Show an error message: 'No ingested sources found — run Ingest Sources first.' and abort without changing the view.

options.label: Error message + abort (mirror the audio path's behavior)
Automatically start the Ingest Sources flow as a fallback

questions.prompt: Should the source-assess path include the full SFL analysis + HITL fact-check loop that the audio path runs?
questions.description: run_full_assessment runs per-chunk SFL tagging, claim detection, and optional human-in-the-loop bypass. This is the bulk of its complexity. Sources are pre-written text (not spoken dialog), so SFL speaker tracking isn't applicable.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes — include SFL and the HITL fact-check loop, but skip speaker-diarization logic since sources have no speaker turns.

options.label: Full SFL + HITL fact-check, speaker diarization skipped
Scoring only (generate_assessment) — skip SFL and HITL for MVP
Full parity with audio path including all SFL fields (diarization left empty)

questions.prompt: What test coverage should be added?
questions.description: Existing tests: tests/unit/app/test_assessment_context.py covers run_full_assessment context logic. tests/unit/tui/ covers assessment_view and keypress.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Unit tests for run_source_assessment (happy path + no-sources error), plus a keypress test for the new trigger key.

options.label: Unit test for run_source_assessment (happy path + no-sources error)
Keypress test for the new trigger binding
Integration/VCR test covering the full source-assess flow
